data.claim: If the workspace is strictly deterministic with respect to its inputs, the safety guarantee collapses to idempotency: the protocol must durably record the full entropy tape and external oracle log, making any displaced evidence recoverable by deterministic replay rather than preventing displacement. The workspace is a pure function of the problem input plus consumed entropy. The protocol durably records the problem input hash, a sequential log of all external random seeds and oracle responses, and intermediate Merkle checkpoints. Crash without terminal record triggers automatic deterministic replay from the last checkpoint. The scratch workspace can be safely reclaimed because evidence exists either in the durable intent log or is reconstructible.
